name: Metformin
uses: Metformin helps control blood sugar levels in people with type 2 diabetes. It works by reducing how much sugar the liver releases and helping the body respond better to insulin.
side_effects: Common side effects include nausea, diarrhea, stomach upset, and a metallic taste in the mouth. These often ease after the first few weeks.
warnings: Take metformin with food to reduce stomach upset. Tell your doctor if you have kidney problems before starting it.

name: Lisinopril
uses: Lisinopril is used to treat high blood pressure and heart failure, and to help protect the kidneys in people with diabetes.
side_effects: Common side effects include a dry cough, dizziness, and tiredness, especially when starting the medicine.
warnings: Stand up slowly to avoid dizziness. Tell your doctor right away if your face, lips, or throat swell.

name: Atorvastatin
uses: Atorvastatin lowers LDL ("bad") cholesterol and raises HDL ("good") cholesterol, reducing the risk of heart attack and stroke.
side_effects: Common side effects include muscle aches, joint pain, and mild digestive upset.
warnings: Tell your doctor about any unexplained muscle pain or weakness. Avoid large amounts of grapefruit juice.

name: Aspirin
uses: Low-dose aspirin is often used to help prevent heart attacks and strokes by reducing blood clotting. Higher doses relieve pain and reduce fever.
side_effects: Common side effects include stomach upset and a higher chance of bruising or bleeding.
warnings: Take with food to protect the stomach. Tell your doctor before any surgery or dental work.

name: Levothyroxine
uses: Levothyroxine replaces a thyroid hormone the body isn't making enough of, treating an underactive thyroid (hypothyroidism).
side_effects: Side effects are uncommon at the right dose, but too high a dose can cause a fast heartbeat, nervousness, or trouble sleeping.
warnings: Take on an empty stomach, first thing in the morning, and wait at least 30 minutes before eating.

name: Amlodipine
uses: Amlodipine relaxes blood vessels, treating high blood pressure and chest pain (angina).
side_effects: Common side effects include swelling in the ankles or feet, flushing, and headache.
warnings: Tell your doctor if swelling in your legs becomes severe. Rise slowly from sitting or lying down.

name: Omeprazole
uses: Omeprazole reduces stomach acid, treating heartburn, acid reflux, and stomach ulcers.
side_effects: Common side effects include headache, stomach pain, and nausea.
warnings: Long-term use may affect vitamin B12 and bone health — your doctor may check on this from time to time.

name: Metoprolol
uses: Metoprolol slows the heart rate and reduces blood pressure, treating high blood pressure, chest pain, and some heart rhythm problems.
side_effects: Common side effects include tiredness, dizziness, and cold hands or feet.
warnings: Do not stop taking metoprolol suddenly without talking to your doctor — stopping abruptly can be dangerous.
